text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's such a nice day... but I... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I find Rice Shower<n>walking through the
park looking<n>defeated.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Big Brother... Um, it's no big deal,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Big Sister... Um, it's no big deal,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I came here because I wanted to<n>sketch the
scenery, but I forgot my<n>sketchbook...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd just buy a new one, butthey're sold out everywhere I go.Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Depressed, Rice Shower stares<n>listlessly at the
sun's beautiful<n>reflection on the water.
